description:
Owning a home doesn't come with a manual- but I'm here to help!

My mission is simple: to give homeowners the knowledge and confidence to understand, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair their homes.

As a home inspector with over 24 years of experience and a lifelong DIY enthusiast, I’ve learned that homeownership doesn’t have to be overwhelming. I believe that an informed homeowner is a more confident homeowner.

That’s why every video is designed to simplify homeownership, save you time and money, and help you tackle projects with confidence.

Whether you’re here to solve a problem, learn a new skill, or better understand how your home works, I’m glad you’re here.

Subscribe and join me as we continue your home education, one video at a time.
